fusions.name: No Detours
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles straight to the target and strikes with your weapon, dealing 11 damage and making it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm the Quarry
fusions.desc: Sets on every enemy within 4 tiles and deals 25 damage that ignores resistances. It grows 8% stronger for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Tireless Trot
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hive Momentum
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you move and attack 3% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
